issues.title: Cambodia protests alleged Thai trench construction near Boundary Pillar No. 9.
issues.title_en: Cambodia protests alleged Thai trench construction near Boundary Pillar No. 9.
issues.summary: Cambodia has lodged a fresh protest against what it described as Thailand’s continued violations of Cambodian sovereignty and territorial integrity, alleging that Thai forces used heavy machinery to construct an earthen trench near Boundary Pillar No. 9 The post Cambodia protests alleged Thai trench construction near Boundary Pillar No. 9. appeared first on Khmer Times .
